title: Recipe and Group Chat
author: Dominic Thornbury
blurb: Wren Delacroix, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent fifteen years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
